tell: A CDK4/6 inhibitor metabolized mainly by CYP3A and SULT2A1, accumulating about 2.4-fold with once-daily dosing.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is 46%, and a high-fat meal raises exposure by about 22%. About 85% is protein bound, and it is cleared mainly by hepatic metabolism through CYP3A and SULT2A1.
A molecular weight of 447.5, with high solubility at or below pH 4 that falls significantly above pH 4.
Approved under an NDA as 75, 100 and 125 mg tablets, dosed once daily.
No boxed warning and no contraindications. In a labelled combination regimen, decreased neutrophils and hemoglobin, stomatitis and diarrhea are among the most common reactions.
HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced or metastatic breast cancer, with an aromatase inhibitor or fulvestrant; PIK3CA-mutated disease with inavolisib and fulvestrant.
Inhibits cyclin-dependent kinases 4 and 6, blocking progression from G1 into S phase and reducing Rb phosphorylation.
The generic name begins with P and has eleven letters.
